detail.longDescription: EXCLUSIVE: More than four years after Russia’s full-scale invasion, fungi scientists at the M.G. Kholodny Institute of Botany have been forced to adapt to increasingly difficult working conditions. “I don't think that someone who has not had the experience of surviving during war can understand the conditions in which people live and work in Ukraine,” says researcher Margarita Lomberg. https://www. thexylom.com/post/ukrainian-my cologists-are-not-giving-up/ # ukraine # research # ecology # news
